en: Paṭṭhānapakaraṇa:
Dhammapaccanīyānuloma (4), Dukatikapaṭṭhānapāḷi (3) 21.55.
Piṭṭhiduka, Sanidassanattika (The Subsequent Pair: The Triplet on the Visible)

Dependent on a state that is not to be abandoned by seeing, is neither visible nor impinging, there arises a state that is not to be abandoned by seeing, is visible, and is impinging, by way of root condition. (Abbreviated.
Under root condition there are three; under predominance condition there are three … pe … under result condition there is one … pe … under non-disappearance condition there are three.

Dependent on a state that is not to be abandoned by cultivation, is neither visible nor impinging, there arises a state that is not to be abandoned by cultivation, is visible, and is impinging, by way of root condition. (Abbreviated.)
With respect to root condition, three; with respect to predominance condition, three ... pe ... with respect to resultant condition, one ... pe ... with respect to non-disappearance condition, three.

Dependent on a state that has a root to be abandoned by seeing, which is both visible and impinging, there arises a state that has a root to be abandoned by seeing, which is visible and impinging, by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. With respect to root condition, three; with respect to predominance condition, three ...
pe ... with respect to resultant condition, one ... pe ... with respect to non-disappearance condition, three.

Dependent on a state that is not to be abandoned by cultivation, has no root-cause, is visible, and is impinging, there arises a state that is not to be abandoned by cultivation, has a root-cause, is visible, and is impinging, by way of root-condition. (Abbreviated.
There are three under root-condition, three under predominance-condition … pe … one under result-condition … pe … three under non-disappearance-condition.

Dependent on a state that is without applied thought, is not visible, and is impinging, there arises a state that is without applied thought, is visible, and is impinging, by way of root-condition. (Abbreviated.)
With respect to the root condition, there are three; with respect to the predominance condition, there are three ... pe ... with respect to the non-disappearance condition, there are three.

Dependent on a state that is without sustained application, with visibility, and impinging, a state that is without sustained application, with visibility, and impinging arises by way of the root condition. (Abbreviated. With respect to the root condition, there are three;
with respect to the predominance condition, there are three ... pe ... with respect to the non-disappearance condition, there are three.

Dependent on a state that is without rapture, with visible appearance, and impinging, there arises a state that is without rapture, with visible appearance, and impinging, by way of root condition. (Abbreviated.
Three for root; three for predominance … pe … three for non-disappearance.

Dependent on a state that is not accompanied by rapture, with visible appearance, and impinging, there arises a state that is not accompanied by rapture, with visible appearance, and impinging, by way of root condition. (Abbreviated.)
With respect to the root condition, three; with respect to the predominance condition, three … pe … with respect to the non-disappearance condition, three.

Dependent on a state that is neither accompanied by pleasure nor visible and impinging, there arises a state that is neither accompanied by pleasure but is visible and impinging, by way of the root condition. (Abbreviated. With respect to the root condition, three;
with respect to the predominance condition, three … pe … with respect to the non-disappearance condition, three.

Dependent on a state that is not accompanied by equanimity, is non-visible, and is impinging, there arises a state that is not accompanied by equanimity, is visible, and is impinging, by way of root condition. (Abbreviated.
Three for root; three for predominance … [and so on] … three for non-disappearance.

Dependent on a state that does not belong to the sense sphere, is non-visible, and is impinging, there arises a state belonging to the sense sphere that is visible and impinging, by way of root condition. (Abbreviated.)
With respect to the root condition, three; with respect to the predominance condition, three … pe … with respect to the non-disappearance condition, three.

Dependent on a state that is not of the fine-material sphere, not visible, and impinging, there arises a state that is not of the fine-material sphere, visible, and impinging, by way of the root condition. (Abbreviated. With respect to the root condition, three;
with respect to the predominance condition, three … pe … with respect to the non-disappearance condition, three.

Dependent on a state that is not of the form-sphere, is non-visible, and is impinging, there arises a state that is not of the form-sphere, is visible, and is impinging, by way of root condition. (Abbreviated.
Three for root; three for predominance … pe … one for result … pe … three for non-disappearance.

Dependent on a state that is not included [in the mundane], is non-visible, and is impinging, there arises a state that is included, is visible, and is impinging, by way of root condition. (Abbreviated.)
With respect to the root condition, three; with respect to the predominance condition, three … pe … with respect to non-disappearance, three.
Dependent on a state that is not leading out, visible, and impinging, there arises a state that is not leading out, visible, and impinging, by way of the root condition. (Abbreviated.
With respect to the root condition, three; with respect to the predominance condition, three … pe … with respect to result, one … pe … with respect to non-disappearance, three.

Dependent on a state that is indeterminate, non-visible, and impinging, there arises an indeterminate state that is visible and impinging by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Under root condition there are three;
under predominance condition there are three … pe … under result condition there is one … pe … under non-disappearance condition there are three.
Dependent on a state that is not surpassable, non-visible, and impinging, there arises a surpassable state that is visible and impinging by way of root condition. (Abbreviated.)

With respect to the root condition (hetu), there are three; with respect to the predominance condition (adhipati), there are three … [and so on] … with respect to the non-disappearance condition (avigata), there are three.

Dependent on a state that is non-conflict (na-araṇa), non-visible (na-sanidassana), and impinging (sappaṭigha), a state that is conflict-free (araṇa), visible (sanidassana), and impinging arises by way of the root condition … one.
Dependent on a state that is non-conflict, non-visible, and impinging, a state that is conflict-free, visible, and impinging arises by way of the root condition … one.

Dependent on a state that is non-conflict (*araṇa*), with visibility (*sanidassana*), and impingement (*sappaṭigha*), as well as a state that is non-conflict, with visibility, and impingement, there arises a state that is non-conflict, with visibility, and impingement, by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Under root condition there are three;
under predominance condition there are three … [as above] … under result condition there is one … [as above] … under non-disappearance condition there are three.

(For the non-visible-with-impingement, there are likewise only three. Under root condition there are three; under predominance condition there are three … [as above] … under mutuality condition there is one … [as above] … under result condition there is one … [as above] … under non-disappearance condition there are three.

Dependent on a state that is non-conflict (*araṇa*), non-demonstrable (*anidassana*), and non-reactive (*appaṭigha*), there arises a state that is non-conflict, non-demonstrable, and non-reactive, by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Under root [condition] there is one; under predominance [condition] there is one... pe ... under non-disappearance [condition] there is one. Negative: Not-root, not-object.

Dependent on a state that is non-conflict (*araṇa*), non-visible (*na-sanidassana*), and non-reactive (*appaṭigha*), a state that is non-conflict, visible, and reactive arises by way of the not-root condition (*na-hetu-paccaya*) … one.

Dependent on a state that is non-conflict, non-visible, and non-reactive, a state that is non-conflict, visible, and reactive arises by way of the not-object condition (*na-ārammaṇa-paccaya*) … three.
(Abbreviated. Under the not-root condition there is one; under the not-object condition there are three.
With predominance condition, three; ... pe ... with kamma condition, one; with nutriment, faculty, jhāna, and path conditions, one; ... pe ... with non-disappearance condition, three.
With root condition and not-object condition, three. (Abbreviated.
With not-object condition and root condition, three. (Abbreviated.)
(The sections on co-nascence, conditionality, dependence, association, and conjunction should also be expanded in detail. 21.55.7.
Question Section: Root Condition (Hetu)

A state that is without conflict (*araṇa*), non-visible (*anidassana*), and impinging (*sappaṭigha*) is a condition, by way of root-condition (*hetu-paccaya*), for a state that is without conflict, visible (*sanidassana*), and impinging.
A state that is without conflict, non-visible, and impinging is a condition, by way of root-condition, for a state that is without conflict, visible, and impinging. (Abbreviated.)

Under root-condition there are two; under predominance-condition there are two ... pe ... under conascence and dependence there are three; under postnascence and kamma there are two; under resultant there is one; under nutriment, faculty, jhāna, path, dissociation there are two ... pe ... under non-disappearance there are three.
(Just as the positive, negative, positive-negative, and negative-positive enumerations were calculated for the "Investigation Chapter" of the Wholesome Triplet, so should they be calculated here.)
